Stellarium 1.2.0 moves to Selkies 2.0, and the desktop now sizes itself to your browser window.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Built on Selkies 2.0.** The LinuxServer base image ships the first stable Selkies release in two years, with a reworked web client, a stats panel in the sidebar and a two-way clipboard that carries text, images and formatted content.
- **The screen follows your browser window, so the screen size setting is gone.** The X server no longer reserves a 530 MB framebuffer up front for the largest screen; Selkies resizes the screen to the window you open. `MAX_RES` and `MAX_RES_CUSTOM` have no effect any more and are removed from the template, and a value left in an existing template is harmless.
- **No Zink override on NVIDIA GPUs.** The new base renders the desktop differently, and forcing the Zink driver there stops OpenGL windows from opening, so this image follows the base.
- **An empty password still means no login.** The base now treats an empty `PASSWORD` field from the template as unset, so this image's own workaround for it is gone.
